notes: A hard zero-emissions cap with the must-run existing coal unit (20 % of 300 MW, ~1289 t/day floor) and no load shedding: infeasible for every setting of the Tier-A and Tier-B keys. The three levers that restore feasibility — raise co2_cap_t, allow load shedding, or drop the cap — are all Tier C, so the correct outcome is needs_human. This is the pypsa_toy replicate of the headline GVR measurement.
